overview.description: The AAM Brentview Dividend Growth ETF (BDIV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund seeks current income and long-term capital appreciation through an actively managed portfolio of 30 to 40 US-listed stocks. Companies selected for the fund are considered best positioned, based on fundamental criteria, to grow their dividend. BDIV was launched on Jul 30, 2024 and is issued by Advisors Asset Management.
